summary: An assignment to alias.NAME, where alias is a relative sibling module and NAME is ALL_CAPS and only imported (re-exported) by that module, rewrites the facade's copy and fails the build; suppress with a reasoned # reexport-write-ok marker.
changelog: - New gate `global_write_via_reexport_alias` (hard, no advisory mode): `alias.NAME = v` where `alias` is a relative sibling module that only re-exports NAME (via `from .impl import NAME`) fails; the write has no effect on the owning module. Relative imports resolve across files. Suppress with `# reexport-write-ok: <reason>`.
owner_actions: Add a [[gate]] entry for global_write_via_reexport_alias to src/py_ci_shared/registry.toml and a README catalogue row (owner-owned files; not edited here).
mlframe's semgrep hook (.semgrep.yml) covers the same rule as an advisory manual hook; the hard gate supersedes it on the shard that runs this gate.
